branchName.commandInputTemplate:
Format: <type>/<kebab-case-description> (e.g. feat/add-metrics, fix/auth-token).
Rules:
- English only.
- NEVER include milestone, sprint, or phase numbers (e.g. NEVER feat/phase-3.1-scaffold).
- Keep concise and descriptive.
{basePrompt}

commitMessage.commandInputTemplate:
Format: <type>(<scope>): <short summary in imperative mood>
Rules:
- English only.
- Conventional Commits format (feat, fix, chore, docs, refactor, test).
- Strictly NO AI attribution, NO 'Co-Authored-By' trailers, NO bot emojis, NO 'Generated with' footers.
{basePrompt}

pullRequest.commandInputTemplate:
Format:
## Why
<problem description>

## What changed
<bullet points of key changes>

## Verification
<commands run and test outputs proving completion>

Rules:
- English only.
- NO AI attribution or bot signatures.
- NO internal milestone/phase references in title or body.
{basePrompt}

fixChecks.commandInputTemplate:
Investigate failing check output. Fix root cause or record a ticket. Follow Definition of Done §4.
{basePrompt}

resolveComments.commandInputTemplate:
For each reviewer comment, apply the fix, file a ticket with root cause, or decline with a reasoned explanation. Never leave unread.
{basePrompt}
